crossRefs.note: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and…
Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and…
Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and…
Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and…
Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other…
Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and…
God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

people.name: Seth
people.line: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line

translations.web: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: and the days of Adam after he begat Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters.
